body:
# Description:

Distinguished is a funny Resource Pack that makes mobs distinguished and elegent. It gives **most** hostile mobs top hats, monocles, and canes.

# Important:

This is a passion project and will not likely get updated consistently


[[EMF] Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) is **required**
